answer: We bound the propagation of malicious weight across the sparse cuts of a network via a spectral ridge that isolates adversarial clusters. In this graph, personalized trust attenuates exponentially beyond a topological horizon, restricted by a cryptographic cipher verifying zero-knowledge proofs. By coupling this structural decay with staking collateral subject to slashing penalties, the expected utility of a Sybil attack becomes negative, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium where honest consensus remains invariant.
